m8_release_blocker_closure.historical_record: The M8 threat review remains an immutable pre-M9 snapshot; this contract supplies the M9 closure evidence rather than rewriting that review.

admission.off_topic_or_scope_failure: zero provider calls and consent remains unconsumed
admission.invalid_consent_or_rate_limit_failure: zero provider calls and a valid unused consent remains unconsumed

rate_limit.storage: bounded process-memory counters only; no browser storage, disk, database, telemetry or content diagnostics
rate_limit.reservation: one fixed provider attempt reserves capacity atomically before one-use consent consumption; provider failure is still charged and never retried
rate_limit.lifecycle: expired counters are pruned; session and controlled-shutdown clear operations are available; M10 must retain one limiter for its server lifetime

cancellation.probe: injected server-side callable only; exception fails closed as cancellation
cancellation.before_provider: checks occur before scope and again before consent/network admission
cancellation.after_provider: a cancellation observed after response sanitization returns local_only with no external lease
cancellation.in_flight_transport: M9 has no route or asynchronous transport cancellation; M10 must compose stream disconnect cancellation with this boundary

privacy_and_failure_isolation.safe_results: only fixed reason codes and optional sanitized leases cross the adapter boundary; caught exceptions, raw provider bodies, exact questions and subscription tokens never do
privacy_and_failure_isolation.provider_down_or_malformed_response: local_only assistant_web_provider_unavailable, one attempt, no ordinary-search fallback
privacy_and_failure_isolation.external_citation: successful evidence remains external_untrusted with a provider ID, canonical approved URL, source age and retrieval time; M9-04 separately binds any external claim citation
privacy_and_failure_isolation.offline_test_policy: all security tests use in-process fake transports or httpx MockTransport; no live provider key, Brave request, DNS lookup or result URL fetch is permitted

content: active-content and prompt-override rejection in en, ru, de, zh-CN, fr and es-ES
